CommunityMessage: no product-owner confirmation that the community host should be subject to the same credit gate as any other member when posting in their own community -- built literally per the frozen contract (no exemption specified), flagged for a real decision.

SYSTEMIC (Phase 6 finding, highest priority): no resource that returns a bare wawuId (ContentPiece.creatorWawuId, DirectMessage.creatorWawuId/senderWawuId, CommunityMessage.senderWawuId, Community.hostWawuId) joins a display name/handle/avatar. Every affected frontend surface falls back to the raw id or a generic placeholder ('Creator'/'Buyer') rather than a real name. Needs either a batch profile-lookup endpoint or per-resource joins.

PRODUCT DECISION NEEDED: the designed OTP screen (design/screens/WAWU Auth.dc.html) collects and displays an EMAIL address, but WAWU ID's only OTP capability (POST /auth/otp/verify) is phone-based, WhatsApp-delivered -- there is no email-OTP endpoint anywhere. Frontend now wired to the real phone-based flow (src/types/auth.ts's OtpVerifyPayload), but the screen's copy still says 'email' and WAWU-ID's register() endpoint issues tokens immediately with no OTP step ever actually triggered in the current sign-up flow. Needs a product decision: drop the OTP step for email/password signup, or rebuild it around phone/WhatsApp.

No Flutterwave inline-checkout SDK wired into the frontend anywhere yet. Every payment-shaped flow (content unlock, tips, DM send, CAC application, credits purchase, subscribe/upgrade) uses a synthetic-transaction-id-then-verify bridge against the backend's MockFlutterwaveAdapter, matching the pre-existing content-unlock pattern. Works end-to-end locally against the mock adapter; will NOT represent a real charge once a real Flutterwave key is configured -- a real checkout-widget integration is required before any payment flow can go live.

FollowRelationship has no GET (am-I-following) endpoint; Community has no leave/unjoin endpoint; SavedItem's list returns bare rows with no embedded ContentPiece (frontend enriches client-side via a follow-up getContent() call per row, currently returns [] live because ContentPiece responses themselves lack a creator object -- see the systemic gap above); GET /users/:wawuId/public-profile has no fullName/location/verificationLevel/dmEnabled/dmPrice fields, only counts.
GET /explore/creators (creator discovery/listing) has no real backend endpoint at all -- stays mock-only, cannot be substituted by /search (requires non-empty free-text q).

Local dev port collision risk for Phase 8: WAWU ID's main.ts and Next.js's `next dev` both default to port 3000. Must explicitly set one aside (e.g. PORT=3002 for local WAWU-ID + NEXT_PUBLIC_WAWU_ID_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3002) when running all three services together.
